Experience Range: At least 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in Java fullstack development, including significant exposure to microservices architecture Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop scalable Java-based fullstack applications leveraging microservices architecture to meet business requirements
  • Implement and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using Spring Boot and Hibernate, ensuring robust performance and security
  • Build responsive user interfaces with AngularJS or React JS, utilizing advanced features of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
  • Integrate applications with relational databases such as MySQL and Oracle RDBMS, optimizing for data integrity, query performance, and scalability
  • Containerize and deploy applications using Docker, streamlining development workflows and ensuring consistency across environments
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features and enhancements within project timelines
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the application stack, maintaining high availability and reliability
  • Optimize application performance and scalability through code reviews, refactoring, and adoption of industry best practices
    • Required Skills:
  • Java (advanced proficiency)
  • Spring Boot
  • Spring Core
  • Hibernate
  • Microservices architecture
  • AngularJS or React JS (advanced)
  • Relational database integration with MySQL and Oracle RDBMS
  • Docker
    • Preferred Skills:
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
  • Familiarity with advanced front-end frameworks (e.g., Vue.js, Svelte)
  • Experience with distributed systems or event-driven architectures
    • Desired Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Software Engineering
  • Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE Programmer or equivalent Java certification
  • Certification in microservices architecture or cloud technologies (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Azure Developer Associate)
